goal: Constrain organic interface growth to actual contact demand and retain necessary compact corners as legal single roads.
diagnosis: Classic density-dependent outward smoothing grew an already computed organic contact projection into unrelated trunks.
A reused precomputed interface layer appeared in both merged input lists.
The initial bounded candidate exposed four necessary compact corner loops; single-road handling must cover exclusions and narrow rescue output.
correction: Close only half-bead seams in non-bed organic projected top contact demand; retain native structural planning outside that region and normal bottom landing transitions.
Keep each precomputed layer pointer once in the merged lists.
Use a legal one-way original arc when a compact contour cannot have a printable hollow interior or a legal interior medial road.
Apply compact source arcs after narrow rescue only to generic top interfaces; retain the original shared true-contact planner and bottom-interface footprint.
Allow collision-safe first-layer bearing rows inside the original support footprint when an upper hollow trunk requires them; the bed is their foundation.
Keep genuine holes, collision domains, process flow, true contacts, tree placement and bed foundation protected.

result.method: All selected native cases run once in three Catch2 shards with separate TEMP directories; exact case names match the native XML inventory with no missing or duplicate cases.

material.method: Compare complete deposited components at actual physical road bottoms; verify contact gaps from actual G-code height and XY-overlapping model surface; inspect actual upper roads using retained short interfaces.
material.shift_method: Translation from first matching model plane bounds; validation input contains one model instance.

projection.method: Compare raw native roof interfaces to actual projected top contacts and precomputed organic roofs. Exact closing is independently approximated with GEOS mitre joins; the half-bead envelope is a separate conservative growth bound. Bottom landing projections retain the original transition regularization and are excluded from the roof-only growth bound.

compact_corner_bearing.method: Recheck the exact upper centerline portions previously borne by the four candidate corner loops against all final deposited lower roads; use the same bead-overlap criterion as initial demand inspection.
